verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports scanning entire codebases/monorepos, cross-file analysis, and 'Managed Scans' for bulk onboarding many repositories at once (semgrep-docs-1, semgrep-docs-2, semgrep-docs-15), plus an API to list projects/findings across a deployment (semgrep-docs-17) — all enabling bulk-scale operations. However, these are CI/CLI batch-scan features rather than AI-agent-invoked bulk operations, and community evidence flags real performance limits at scale (semgrep-comm-2, semgrep-comm-7). missing for 10: evidence of AI-native/agentic bulk actions (e.g., MCP-driven bulk triage, bulk fix/apply across many findings), and independent confirmation that bulk onboarding/API scales well in practice.
